// Fixture for app_check rule directional (not compiled): the allowed forms.
// The test places it at lib/features/today/presentation/ok_layout.dart and
// expects no violation at all.

// EdgeInsets.only(left: 8) in a comment is not code.
Widget okLayout() => Column(
  children: [
    Padding(padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 8, end: 4)),
    Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 8)),
    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16)),
    Padding(padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(1, 2, 3, 4)),
    PositionedDirectional(start: 0, top: 0, child: x),
    Align(alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart),
    Align(alignment: Alignment.center),
    Text(l10n.x, textAlign: TextAlign.start),
    Icon(Icons.arrow_back),
    Icon(Icons.copyright),
    Icon(Icons.flight),
    ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadiusDirectional.only(topStart: r)),
    DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: BorderDirectional(end: side))),
    Text(isFirst ? left : right),
    Text(l10n.label('left: 4')),
    Icon(Icons.chevron_left), // app-check: allow directional mirrors in RTL (matchTextDirection)
  ],
);
